name: Albassam · Falaj
description: Aziz's private family office: the family's money as one spring whose water reaches each member by their share. v4 'Falaj' (2026-09-28): a scroll-scrubbed hero film of an Arabian falaj channel, a deep-water canvas sampled from the footage, and a dividend-salary calculator (the gate). Supersedes v3 'The Instrument'.

logo.notes: Logo A, 'the channel': one stroke from a spring that splits into three branches ending in three basins, inside a rounded square. Limestone strokes, spring-water basins. It is the fund model drawn: one pool, every share. No raster logo; the site is noindex.

colors.name: Deep water
colors.usage: page canvas, sampled from the deepest shadow of the hero's final frame (#13332E); a slow caustic shimmer layer and faint light glints drift over it

colors.name: Shade pool
colors.usage: panels, payslips, the burn card: vertical gradients #1D4842 to #183F3A with a 1px rgba(237,230,216,.10) hairline

colors.name: Sandstone
colors.usage: secondary text and subtitles (6.4:1 on the canvas); faint tier #A89A82 (5.0:1) for labels and chart axes

colors.name: Hair
colors.usage: hairlines and dividers, written as rgba(237,230,216,.10) and .20 over the canvas

colors.name: Spring water
colors.usage: the one accent: CTAs, the gate, basin amounts, focus rings, chart lines. Rare doses only

colors.name: Clay
colors.usage: losses, US tax, zakat deductions, destructive actions only (6.1:1 on the canvas). Gains use #93D3A8

voice.tone: Calm, safe, custodial, and plain. The brand speaks in the language of water: spring, share, flow, basin, gate. Sentence case, short lines, no exclamation points, no finance jargon a family member would not follow. English only (Arabic script removed by the owner on 2026-07-06 and reconfirmed on 2026-09-28). Money copy is honest: reference yields carry their date and 'not advice'; zakat modes are 'calculator modes, not a fatwa'.

imagery.style: One world: an ancient Arabian falaj photographed straight down in soft early-morning light. Pale limestone, clear aquamarine water, feathered date-palm shadows. The hero film descends from the channel into a round basin; three stills continue the story (the channel splitting into three basins, the same channel in a dry season, the channel feeding a palm garden).
subjects: the falaj channel and its basins
imagery.treatment: Top-down, calm, photoreal, generated on Higgsfield (GPT Image 2.5 stills, Seedance 2.5 video). Every asset shares the palette and light of the hero; no text or logos in imagery. Captions over footage use soft oval scrims (closest-side radial) audited at >= 3.5:1 worst-pixel contrast.

layout.spacing: sections 72-128px apart; 20px to 6vw side gutters; max width 1280px
postureRules: The hero is a pinned 400vh scroll-scrubbed film (Tier 1, one 6-second shot) with three caption bands; phones and reduced motion get a composed still hero over the final frame.

The signature element is the gate: a wooden sluice gate that lifts with the blended yield while water flows down branching channels into one basin per member; the basin pools grow with each person's monthly salary.

No two adjacent sections share a layout skeleton: gate (interactive), payslips, mad-lib sentence, split text/bars, rows, image+controls, chart, split card, comparison rows, registry panels, member rows, history line, ledger list.
The accent (spring water) appears only on actions, the gate, salary figures, focus rings and chart lines. Clay marks losses and deductions only.

Motion: the scrubbed film, one entrance per section (rise with a short stagger that retires), the slow environment layer, a water line drawing down the left gutter, basin ripples. Transform and opacity only. Everything pinned under reduced motion.
The office is private: nothing reads data before the owner's Google sign-in; Firestore rules enforce it.
